name: 01-parent
prompt:
Use case: compositing / ads-marketing. Create ONE premium English App Store promotional screenshot poster, tall portrait aspect ratio 1284:2778. The attached image is the actual KidLoop app screen to feature; preserve its visible UI, text, numbers, icons and layout faithfully. Wrap the supplied screenshot inside one large front-facing black iPhone with a slim black bezel, rounded corners, no perspective distortion, centered below the headline. Do not invent or redesign the app UI.
Cohesive visual system: full-bleed deep forest green #104F3D background, a broad understated looping route line in slightly lighter green sweeping behind the phone, one tiny warm-yellow circular route endpoint, elegant restrained atmosphere. Top small white KidLoop wordmark with simple bus glyph. Tiny mint uppercase audience label below brand. Large bold warm-white modern sans-serif headline, left aligned, two lines, generous spacing, no more than 78% canvas width. Smaller pale mint supporting copy below, max two lines. Header occupies top 25% of canvas, phone begins at 28% canvas height and occupies about 80% width, extends slightly beyond bottom edge, so screenshot details are legible. Large phone and typography, balanced margins. Soft realistic shadow behind phone only. No people, no additional floating UI, no fabricated badges, no app-store download badge, no watermark, no additional claims. Only add the exact text specified below outside the screenshot. The result should feel like a professionally art-directed consistent app marketing campaign, not a plain screenshot.
Exact brand: "KidLoop". Exact audience label: "FOR PARENTS". Exact headline (two lines): "Your child's ride.
At a glance.". Exact supporting copy: "Schedules, drivers and pickup status.".
